plan.rationale: For this design, we'll focus on a modern, clean aesthetic with vibrant colors and a dynamic 3D render. The character will be a young Kenyan boy adventurer, with big expressive eyes and a backpack. The title will be short and impactful, fitting well with the overall composition.

elements.content: A young Kenyan boy adventurer, with a backpack, standing on a rugged landscape.
